title: coryphopteris pauciloba
intro: Coryphopteris pauciloba, commonly known as the 'few-tooth fern', is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Coryphopteris pauciloba include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant, but it has shown promise in traditional medicine for treating various ailments.
